collar_tag_req: All dogs within the Village of Merrickville-Wolford are required to have a dog tag and be registered prior to April 30th of each calendar year.
notes: By-law includes exemptions for Service Dogs and Law Enforcement Work Dogs (No Charge), but no explicit exemptions for livestock guardian dogs or agricultural farm dogs. URL: https://www.merrickville-wolford.ca/residents/animal-control

collar_tag_req: The Clerk of the Municipality or someone designated by him/her shall provide the owner with a dog tag and the owner shall keep the tag securely fixed on the dog at all times until the tag is renewed or replaced.
dog_limit: No person shall keep anymore than three (3) dogs unless a kennel licence has been obtained from the Municipality.
notes: Guide dogs are exempt from the definition of a "Dog" in the context of the bylaw. No LGD provisions or agricultural exemptions exist for limits or licensing. URL: https://melancthontownship.ca/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/canine.pdf

collar_tag_req: All dogs within the Municipality of Mississippi Mills must be licensed. Dog licenses expire on December 31 of each year.
dog_limit: Maximum Number of Dogs Allowed: Almonte, Hamlets, Subdivisions = 3; Areas outside of those listed = 6; Hunters = 12.
notes: While it lacks a specific LGD definition, it features a tiered dog limit offering up to 6 dogs for rural properties outside hamlets/subdivisions and up to 12 dogs for Hunters, which is generally favourable to agricultural/working properties compared to strict flat limits. URL: https://www.mississippimills.ca/municipal-services/animal-control-services/

dog_limit: No person shall own more than four Dogs on property less than one hectare in size located on land zoned Residential 1 or Residential 2.
notes: The by-law sets dog limits strictly for properties less than 1 hectare zoned as Residential, implicitly allowing unrestricted or larger numbers of dogs on properties exceeding 1 hectare or zoned for agriculture/rural use. URL: https://www.neebing.org/media/rx1gnlab/canine-control-by-law-2014-028.pdf

collar_tag_req: Ensure that the Dog identification tag, issued as part of the registration, is displayed on the Dog's collar, and that this collar is affixed to the Dog while the Dog is off of the Owner's Premises.
notes: Service Dogs and police working Dogs are explicitly exempt from licensing fees, but there is no specific mention of agricultural or livestock guardian dogs being exempt. URL: https://www.norfolkcounty.ca/council-administration-and-government/by-laws-and-policies/by-law-directory/animal-care-and-control-by-law/
